properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key for JWT token signing and validation.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. Default: 86400000 (24 h).

properties.name: app.mail.enabled
properties.description: Set to true to enable outgoing email notifications.

properties.name: app.mail.from
properties.description: From address used in all system-generated emails.

properties.name: app.qr.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret used to sign and verify rotating QR code tokens.

properties.name: app.qr.refresh-minutes
properties.description: How often (in minutes) the QR code token rotates. Default: 2.

properties.name: app.meal.cutoff-minutes
properties.description: Minutes before a meal when bookings are no longer accepted. Default: 120.

properties.name: app.meal.grace-minutes
properties.description: Minutes after a meal start when attendance can still be marked. Default: 20.

properties.name: app.wallet.low-balance-threshold
properties.description: Wallet balance in rupees below which a low-balance notification fires. Default: 300.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Use * to allow all (default). In production set to your exact Vercel URL.
